prompt: Append-mode ingest of a labeled fixture source /tmp/wiki-ops-ingest-fixture/notes/architecture-decision.md into a temp vault. Source is new since last ingest.
expected_output: cache-check or manifest.py delta → idea→destination map → distill pages → manifest.py record once after complete → page-scoped wiki-lint until clean → done-summary.

assertions.text: Runs obsidian-wiki cache-check (or python3 scripts/manifest.py delta fallback) before writing pages
Builds an idea→destination map for the source before filing pages
Calls python3 scripts/manifest.py record exactly once after the source is complete — never hashes a failed file as success
Runs page-scoped ./scripts/wiki-lint --json --scope <page> on each produced page and fixes until clean
Does not load the whole .manifest.json into context — uses scripts/manifest.py helpers only
